Microcycle 5 increases frequency to 6 days per week employing a traditional bodybuilding-style split routine. Typically training in this type of protocol is carried out on a 3-on/1off basis (e.g., training on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday). Again, the per-session training volume remains constant, as with the previous protocols, but weekly volume is further increased as a result of more frequent training.
